jobs.title: Rekrutmen Badan Amil Zakat Nasional (BAZNAS)
jobs.description: Badan Amil Zakat Nasional (BAZNAS) adalah badan resmi dan satu-satunya yang dibentuk oleh pemerintah berdasarkan Keputusan Presiden RI No. 8 Tahun 2001 yang memiliki tugas dan fungsi menghimpun dan menyalurkan zakat, infak, dan sedekah (ZIS) pada tingkat nasional. Berikut ini lowongan kerja Badan Amil Zakat Nasional (BAZNAS). Lahirnya Undang-Undang Nomor 23 Tahun 2011 tentang Pengelolaan Zakat semakin mengukuhkan peran BAZNAS sebagai lembaga yang berwenang melakukan pengelolaan zakat secara nasional. Dalam UU tersebut, BAZNAS dinyatakan sebagai lembaga pemerintah nonstruktural yang bersifat mandiri dan bertanggung jawab kepada Presiden melalui Menteri Agama. Dalam mengelola zakat, BAZNAS menerapkan prinsip 3A, yakni Aman Syari, Aman Regulasi, dan Aman NKRI. Aman Syari artinya pengelolaan zakat yang dilaksanakan BAZNAS harus selaras dengan koridor hukum syari. Pengelolaan zakat harus selaras dan tidak boleh bertentangan dengan sumber hukum Islam, Al-Quran dan Sunnah. Aman Regulasi artinya bahwa pengelolaan zakat harus memperhatikan rambu-rambu peraturan hukum dan perundangan. Dann werde Teil unseres Teams bei Aever Clinics in München! Über Aever Clinics Aever Clinics gehört zu einer wachsenden europäischen Klinikgruppe im Bereich Beauty, Hautgesundheit und ästhetische Behandlungen. Wir verbinden moderne Technologien, hochwertige Behandlungen und eine persönliche Betreuung, um unseren Kund erstklassige Ergebnisse zu ermöglichen. jobs.title: Research Scientist, Protein Design & Engineering
jobs.description: About us We're reverse-engineering the origin of life — one of the great unsolved problems in science, and one we think AI finally makes tractable. Understanding this transition, from geochemistry to biochemistry, is what will let us orchestrate molecular networks and build systems that are more capable, adaptive, and efficient. If we succeed, the applications are vast: catalysis, green synthesis, ab initio synthetic biology, programmable matter. Understanding and harnessing these processes could let ten billion of us thrive on this planet — and let life keep evolving beyond it. We're a small, diverse team of AI engineers, computational scientists, and bench scientists. We hold ourselves to the rigor of a research institute, but we ship like an engineering firm. Global team, HQs in Cambridge, MA and London, UK. The role You'll engineer proteins to carry out useful chemistry, combining enzyme discovery, directed evolution, and experimental characterisation. You'll own the experimental cycle: choosing starting points, building variant libraries, developing screens, and establishing which changes improve function and why. This is a hands-on role working closely with our computational and ML teams. You'll test designed proteins at the bench, use experimental results to guide subsequent rounds, and develop enzymes with the activity, selectivity, and stability needed for their intended application. There’s no fixed screening pipeline to inherit — you'll help decide how we build it. What you'll do Design and run protein engineering campaigns, from initial enzyme selection and library design through screening and characterisation of improved variants. Build and express variant libraries using site-directed, random, and combinatorial mutagenesis. Develop assays and high-throughput screens that reliably measure the properties we're trying to improve. Only a select few graduate into full Technology Alliances — partnerships significant enough to warrant real commercial investment: co-selling, joint go-to-market programs, and coordinated effort across product, marketing, sales, and partnerships. You'll own 360-degree responsibility for a select group of Apollo's most important technology alliances — the commercial and relationship layer that turns a technical integration into a real go-to-market motion. Where Product Partnerships owns integration depth and breadth (the technical relationship with each partner's R&D org), you own everything commercial: field-level co-selling, joint business planning, co-marketing execution, and stakeholder alignment from the executive level down to the field. jobs.description: Moin, wir sind Nordmut – die Outdoor Brand mit Herz und Vision. Wir entwickeln hochwertiges Outdoor-Equipment für Abenteurer, Camper und Freiheitsliebende. Du hast Bock auf E-Commerce, digitale Marktplätze und nachhaltiges Wachstum? Du denkst unternehmerisch, liebst es, Performance zu analysieren und möchtest unsere Marke auf Plattformen wie Amazon & Co. auf das nächste Level bringen? Wir nämlich auch! Unser Ziel: bis 2030 die führende deutsche Outdoor D2C-Marke zu werden – mit einem skalierbaren, internationalen Geschäftsmodell. Dafür brauchen wir nicht nur starke Produkte und eine klare Vision, sondern auch einen Marketplace Manager, der unsere Marktplatzstrategie aktiv gestaltet, neue Wachstumspotenziale erschließt und unsere internationalen Vertriebskanäle profitabel skaliert. Wir sind ein junges, ambitioniertes Team aus dem Herzen Hamburgs, das seine Mission lebt: Wir inspirieren Menschen, durch die Natur zu sich selbst zu finden und mit hochwertiger Ausrüstung, starker Gemeinschaft und unvergesslichen Abenteuern über sich hinauszuwachsen. Du möchtest Verantwortung übernehmen, eigene Ideen umsetzen und den internationalen Marketplace-Erfolg einer aufstrebenden Outdoor-Marke maßgeblich mitgestalten? Dann brauchen wir genau dich! Aufgaben Dein Verantwortungsbereich Marketplace Management: Du übernimmst die operative und strategische Betreuung unserer Marktplätze wie Amazon, OTTO, Kaufland & Co. und entwickelst diese kontinuierlich weiter. Wachstum & Skalierung: Du identifizierst neue Umsatzpotenziale, entwickelst Wachstumsstrategien und hilfst uns dabei, unsere Marktplätze national und international erfolgreich zu skalieren. jobs.description: About us: Airtm is a financial-infrastructure company building the future of the online-work economy. We are on a mission to empower the world's growing number of Digital Entrepreneurs in the Global South, giving them the financial freedom to thrive. The problem is clear: in emerging markets, accessing the dollar economy is difficult. Cross-border payments are slow, expensive, and often lose value to inflation. This limits the potential of millions of talented individuals. Airtm’s solution is a swift and comprehensive financial platform that facilitates low-value cross-border payments and local cash-outs. As pioneers in stablecoin-payment infrastructure, Airtm has built the most advanced cross-border payment system available on the market. As a company married to the world of online work, Airtm will go beyond payments to build the necessary infrastructure the online-work economy needs to thrive. We are fostering an entirely new economy, giving individuals, communities, and countries the tools to take control of their financial destinies. About the Role We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to design, build, and evolve the full stack systems that power Airtm’s financial products. You’ll work within one of our autonomous product pods, taking ownership of projects end-to-end, from technical design through production, and mentoring the engineers around you. Our stack is TypeScript/Node.js microservices deployed on Kubernetes, paired with React front ends. You’ll work across the entire stack, backend and frontend, as needed to deliver on your pod’s goals, collaborating with engineers in other pods when initiatives cross boundaries. AI-assisted development is core to how we build software: you’ll be expected to use AI coding tools fluently to move faster without sacrificing quality. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer (ML QA)
jobs.description: About the job Build the software that validates Graphcore’s machine learning stack, from frameworks to AI accelerator hardware. You’ll design production-quality test infrastructure that engineers can extend, maintain and rely on as Graphcore’s ML software grows. Your work will help teams deliver reliable products, with clear evidence of numerical accuracy and performance across the stack. You’ll architect scalable test frameworks and build CI/CD pipelines that run across simulators, emulators and physical hardware. You’ll create representative ML workloads, analyse their execution and turn the results into practical improvements to testing and tooling. This role gives you scope to shape software architecture and developer experience, not just add tests to existing systems. You’ll deepen your understanding of the AI compute stack while solving engineering problems that connect software design with hardware behaviour. The team and culture Graphcore’s ML QA engineers build automation, work with industry-standard frameworks and models, and contribute to upstream open-source projects. You’ll work across software teams, using code and design reviews to strengthen quality, security and maintainability. You’ll use workload results to challenge assumptions and guide technical decisions about how Graphcore tests its ML stack. You’ll own improvements, act quickly on testing gaps and mentor junior engineers to raise the team’s technical standards. What we’re looking for Strong Python skills, demonstrated through designing, developing and maintaining production-quality software. Software design and architecture skills for large, complex codebases, with a focus on testability and long-term maintainability. Experience building CI/CD pipelines and automated testing systems in Linux environments. Familiarity with C or C++, including the ability to read, debug and reason about low-level code. jobs.title: Senior SoC Architect
jobs.description: Shape the high-speed interfaces and silicon sub-systems behind Graphcore’s next AI acceleration platforms. As a Senior SoC Architect in Bristol, you’ll translate product requirements into specifications for complex, highly integrated, high-performance silicon devices. You’ll own sub-system architecture, modelling, validation and evaluation, connecting early design choices with practical implementation. You’ll help determine how critical components work together, balancing product needs with implementation trade-offs. Those choices will support the specialised compute that lets AI innovators tackle more demanding problems. You’ll assess third-party hard and soft IP, work with vendors and specify how sub-systems integrate across the platform. You’ll also contribute to silicon bring-up, characterisation and evaluation when your expertise is needed. Your contribution won’t stop at a specification document. You’ll deepen your understanding of AI acceleration by seeing how architectural decisions play out in working silicon. The team and culture Reporting to the Director of Silicon Architecture, you will be working with processor, SoC and system architects. Silicon design, verification, hardware and software engineers are partners in evaluating options and checking implementation correctness. You’ll represent the team in cross-functional working groups, making trade-offs clear and speaking up when designs need further scrutiny. You’ll help teams move forward by resolving complex bugs and improving engineering processes. Mentoring engineers will let you share your judgement and help others develop theirs. What we’re looking for A degree in Electronic Engineering, Computer Science or a related subject. A solid understanding of computer and SoC architecture. Experience writing clear technical specifications. Knowledge of RTL development and verification processes. The ability to explain design choices clearly and work across engineering teams. Confidence

jobs.title: Member of Scientific Staff, Cell Culture and Functional Assays
jobs.description: LOCATION: King's Cross, London · PATTERN: Lab-based, full-time The opportunity We're a stealth startup in AI and bio, building infrastructure for data generation. The team is small and elite, the problems are hard, and the foundations are being laid right now. You'd help write them from the first line, with real ownership and a direct line to the founders. This role covers the cell side of our protein characterisation work. You would keep the cell lines healthy and run the assays that show how a designed protein behaves on a living cell, week after week, to the same standard. About us AI for biology has a data problem. The data that matters most doesn't exist yet, so we're building the infrastructure to produce it, with quality and traceability built in from day one. We're in stealth and heads-down on execution. We'll share more about what we're building once you've spoken with the team. The role You will run cell culture and the cell-based assays for our protein characterisation work. That means the mammalian lines the assays depend on, from thaw through routine passage to a banked and documented stock, and the weekly rhythm of seeding, treating, reading and reporting plates. Most of it runs in 384-well plates with imaging-based or flow cytometry readouts. You will run those assays as designed, with the controls and replicates that make a curve defensible, and you will be the person who notices when a plate, a line or a reagent lot has started to drift. Assay design and the shape of the cascade sit with the scientist who leads this work today, so you are not being asked to invent the panel. You are being asked to make it run the same way every week, to record what you did in a form the rest of the system can read, and to tighten the protocols as they settle, including moving them towards the plate formats our automation will take on. jobs.description: LOCATION: King's Cross, London · PATTERN: Lab-based, full-time The opportunity We're a stealth startup in AI and bio, building infrastructure for data generation. The team is small and elite, the problems are hard, and the foundations are being laid right now. You'd help write them from the first line, with real ownership and a direct line to the founders. This role sits at the start of our protein work. Every measurement we make depends on the protein in the well being the right one, made the same way every time, and you would be one of the people making it. About us AI for biology has a data problem. The data that matters most doesn't exist yet, so we're building the infrastructure to produce it, with quality and traceability built in from day one. We're in stealth and heads-down on execution. We'll share more about what we're building once you've spoken with the team. The role You will make proteins, many of them at once. The work runs from DNA through to purified, quality-checked protein in 96-well format, ready for the binding and biophysical assays downstream of you. On the DNA side you will prepare expression templates from synthetic gene fragments, by PCR and by Golden Gate or Gibson assembly, and check them before they go forward. You will express proteins in cell-free systems first, with E. coli and mammalian (HEK293) expression following as the menu grows. You will purify them by affinity capture, mostly on magnetic beads in plates, and confirm what you made with quantification, CE-SDS and SEC. Every step is recorded as you go: what went in, which lot, which conditions, what came out, and what failed. Failed expressions and poor yields are kept as data, so they get the same care as the successes. As protocols settle you will help move them from the bench onto liquid handlers and our automated platform, working with the engineers who build it. jobs.description: Woven by Toyota is enabling Toyota’s once-in-a-century transformation into a mobility company. Inspired by a legacy of innovating for the benefit of others, our mission is to challenge the current state of mobility through human-centric innovation — expanding what “mobility” means and how it serves society. Our work centers on four pillars: AD/ADAS, our autonomous driving and advanced driver assist technologies; Arene, our software development platform for software-defined vehicles; Woven City, a test course for mobility; and Cloud & AI, the digital infrastructure powering our collaborative foundation. Business-critical functions empower these teams to execute, and together, we’re working toward one bold goal: a world with zero accidents and enhanced well-being for all. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone. 🏠 Where you'll fit in: Kraken’s technology is written and maintained by a multi-discipline engineering team of around 1,400 people globally, which includes server-side, client-side, and mobile engineers. We follow an agile way of working, where individual teams are given the freedom to choose the tools that are most appropriate for managing their work. Kraken is a great place to learn, work with talented engineers and level-up your skills. Some of our coding conventions are open-source. Our technology Our backend developers use Python. Most of our websites are powered by Django and GraphQL (Graphene). Our CircleCI CI/CD pipeline runs tens of thousands of tests, deploying into AWS EKS defined by Terraform over 100 times per day and observed with tools like Sentry and Datadog. Die MainTea GmbH ist ein Food-Startup aus Frankfurt am Main mit rund 30 Mitarbeitenden und Teil der MainTea-Gruppe. Zur Gruppe gehören mehrere Marken: Besser im Glas (D2C), PRO2BE , Bubble Pop und Bubble Chill , jeweils im Lebensmitteleinzelhandel. Die Produktentwicklung arbeitet für alle diese Marken, und genau dort bist du in deinem Pflichtpraktikum fest im Team: Du verkostest, recherchierst Trends, stimmst dich mit Herstellern und Lieferanten ab und begleitest neue Produkte von der ersten Idee bis ins Regal. Wenn du Food liebst und in einem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen mit flachen Hierarchien echte Verantwortung übernehmen willst, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung, ab sofort oder nach Vereinbarung. Deine Aufgaben Produktentwicklung über alle Marken: Du arbeitest aktiv an Neuentwicklungen und Sortimentserweiterungen für Besser im Glas und PRO2BE, von Tee- und Gewürzmischungen über Protein-Produkte bis zu Getränken. DataSnipper builds the AI that auditors and finance teams rely on to do that work with confidence: agents designed around how audits are actually performed, a platform firms trust with their most sensitive client evidence, and a team built around former auditors who know the work firsthand. We want to define how the profession works in the age of AI. More than 600,000 professionals across 175 countries use DataSnipper, including all Big Four firms, Fortune 500 companies, and government agencies. In 2025 alone, we delivered over $1.4 billion in productivity savings for our customers. Backed by Index Ventures and Insight Partners, we are one of the fastest-growing companies in AI for audit, and the fastest-growing tech company in the Netherlands two years running. Everything we build starts from one principle: AI in audit has to be something professionals can trust, verify, and defend. Joining now means helping lead the profession's shift from manual testing to agentic execution. The Rol e Partnerships are one of DataSnipper's most important growth levers. Across every major market, the consulting firms, technology platforms, and professional networks that organizations rely on shape which technologies their teams and clients adopt. As AI changes how audit work gets done, those partners are deciding who to build with. As Strategic Partnerships Lead, you will lead, build, and launch DataSnipper's partnerships across Europe and the wider EMEA region, spanning our consulting alliances, key technology partners, and strategic relationships across the audit ecosystem and beyond. Our European ecosystem already includes relationships with leading consulting firms and regional networks. Your job is to scale it, and to build what comes next: new partner programs, new markets, and new commercial models. jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Billing & Monetization
jobs.description: About the role Every customer's path through DataSnipper, from first sign-up to first agent run to renewal, runs on systems your team owns. We are hiring an Engineering Manager in our Amsterdam office to lead Billing & Monetization : how customers get in, what they are entitled to, and how AI usage turns into revenue. Why DataSnipper? The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust. We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable. At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empowers those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important. For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output must be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand-new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it. And we build at scale. More than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. In 2025 alone, the DataSnipper platform delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to is customers. Van feta-ovenpasta tot knapperige aardappelsalade en van chopped sandwich tot de omelet uit The Bear - jij was er allemaal als eerste bij. Je maakt foto’s en short-form video’s waar menig maag van gaat rommelen en je weet deze beelden tot hapklare content te maken. Kom jij ons gezellige social team per februari 2027 versterken voor een half jaar? Wat je gaat doen Je bent als eerste op de hoogte van de nieuwste foodtrends en komt met originele ideeën om hierop in te haken op een manier die past bij Crisp. Daarbij krijg je veel vrijheid om je eigen creativiteit in te zetten. Je weet welke ingrediënten er nodig zijn om de lekkerste foto’s en video’s te maken en kunt deze beelden zelf bewerken tot smaakmakende content. Met je handen uit de mouwen mentaliteit ondersteun je ons social team bij het coördineren van foto en videoshoots. Je zit niet elke dag achter je laptop, maar gaat ook regelmatig op pad, bijvoorbeeld om leveranciers te ontmoeten of content te schieten op locatie. Je helpt bij het beheren van de social media kanalen van Crisp. Je houdt de planning bij, zorgt dat alles op rolletjes loopt en draagt bij aan een dynamische, leuke rol binnen een gezellig team. Je bent 32-40 uur per week beschikbaar voor minimaal 5 maanden. jobs.title: Reliability & Maintenance Engineer | DSL-01
jobs.description: Please note: For this role proficiency in both Dutch and English is required. Reliability & Maintenance Engineer | DSL-01 As Reliability & Maintenance Engineer DSL-01, you are responsible for building and continuously improving the facility's maintenance, reliability, and asset integrity framework. Reporting to the Engineering Manager, you help ensure the plant operates safely, reliably, and efficiently. The role starts with a strong Maintenance Engineering focus. Your priority will be to help establish the maintenance and reliability foundation of DSL-01 by answering a fundamental question: "how do we maintain our assets safely, reliably, and efficiently throughout their lifecycle?" You will translate reliability studies, equipment criticality assessments, and integrity requirements into practical maintenance plans, inspection programmes, spare parts strategies, and asset management processes. As the facility moves into stable operations, the focus gradually shifts towards Reliability Engineering, where you will use asset health monitoring, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement to prevent failures and improve long-term asset performance. Working closely with operations, maintenance, engineering, and external specialists, you will help reduce technical risk and improve asset reliability from day one. jobs.description: About ElevenLabs ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. jobs.description: About Voodoo Voodoo is a consumer tech company founded in Paris in 2013, with one mission: entertain the world. Today we are 1,000 people, generating $1b+ in annual revenue, profitably. Our games and apps have passed 7 billion downloads and reach 200 million+ active users every month, making Voodoo the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in downloads, after Google and Meta. We were backed by Goldman Sachs, Tencent and GBL along the way. Team The Engineering & Data team builds innovative tech products and platforms to support the impressive growth of their gaming and consumer apps which allow Voodoo to stay at the forefront of the mobile gaming industry. Helix is our flagship Ad-Network team of around 60 top-tier engineers and data scientists spanning backend, mobile SDKs, data engineering, infrastructure, and AI. Helix has evolved beyond powering Voodoo's own gaming portfolio—our technology is now directly integrated into games from external, third-party publishers worldwide. Operating across millions of third-party devices in real-time bidding environments creates unique technical challenges around SDK performance, ultra-low latency, and intelligent automation. Within Helix, you'll join the RTB team, the group that owns the bidder and the services behind it that help it take the optimal bidding decision. Bidder, pricing, models and data are all built in-house, so nothing is out of reach when you want to change how a bid gets made. You will work with expert backend and machine-learning engineers in real-time bidding, on a system that prices ad requests across mobile gaming in real time, at a scale few teams get to work at. Role We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager - Real Time Bidding to join our Engineering & Data team. In this role, you’ll drive product decisions across the full bidding pipeline. jobs.title: Customer Success Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.description: TL;DR - Wir entwickeln KI-gestützte Fachkräfte für das Gesundheitswesen von morgen. Unsere KI-Rezeptionistin Luna automatisiert bereits heute die Patientenkommunikation in Arztpraxen. Als Marktführer in der Kieferorthopädie und mit einer großen Finanzierungsrunde im Rücken skalieren wir nun in andere medizinische Fachbereiche - und du bist an vorderster Front dabei. Als Customer Success Manager setzt du neue Standards für moderne Kundenbetreuung und -entwicklung und übernimmst die End-to-End Betreuung unserer Kunden und hilfst dabei, Kunden pro-aktiv zum Erfolg mit unserem Produkt zu führen. Wieso praxipal? Der Fachkräftemangel ist die größte Herausforderung für unser Gesundheitswesen. Zehntausende Stellen bleiben jedes Jahr unbesetzt und der demografische Wandel sorgt dafür, dass sich diese Entwicklung immer weiter zuspitzen wird. Arztpraxen setzen auf unsere KI-Rezeptionistin Luna, um ihr Personal zu entlasten und die Versorgung für alle zugänglich zu halten. Wir wachsen in Rekordgeschwindigkeit und haben vor kurzem eine Seed-Finanzierungsrunde in Höhe von $6.7 Millionen mit HV Capital abgeschlossen - und wir fangen gerade erst an. Wir sind ein tech-driven Unternehmen und setzen bewusst auf ein kleines, hochtalentiertes Team. Was uns ausmacht, ist das Tempo und die Intensität, mit der wir arbeiten – aber ebenso wichtig ist uns das Miteinander. Deshalb kommen wir jeden Tag ins Büro: um uns auszutauschen, voneinander zu lernen und gemeinsam zu wachsen. Der Austausch findet bei uns ganz selbstverständlich über Teamgrenzen hinweg statt – im Alltag wirst du dabei vor allem mit Julius, Lisa und Daniel eng zusammenarbeiten. Wonach wir suchen 1–3 Jahre Erfahrung im Customer Success, inklusive der Verantwortung für den kompletten Customer Lifecycle (Onboarding bis Renewal) Sehr gute organisatorische Fähigkeiten mit hohem Anspruch an Qualität und Detailgenauigkeit Klare, überzeugende und empathische Kommunikation – schriftlich wie mündlich Datengetriebene Denkweise: Über Ke

Think semiconductor-fab precision applied to the chaotic world of prototyping and low-volume production: a 10x throughput improvement in one of the world's most foundational industries. Our customers include a major EV maker, a top AI lab and many of the worlds largest companies. The Grid isn't a prototype. It's live, scaling fast and delivering real revenue, and we're building the team that will scale it further. The Role CircuitHub makes electronics on demand. Engineers upload a circuit board design; we buy the parts, build the board in our own robotic factory and ship it. More and more of that business is now run by AI agents, and we want you to help build them. These aren't chatbots. Our agents have real jobs: They inspect boards. An agent checks camera images of every panel we build for wrong, rotated or missing parts. They program robots. Agents read datasheets so our pick-and-place machines know how to handle each new part. They watch the factory. They spot stray parts in robot storage, diagnose printer faults and clear stuck machines. They run the back office. They book supplier invoices, chase late orders, explain quotes and triage bugs. They write our code. Most of what our team ships starts in an agent session. jobs.description: About Us: DeepJudge is Switzerland’s leading AI and ICT scale-up, transforming how law firms and legal departments access and leverage their knowledge. Founded by former Google search engineers with PhDs in AI from ETH Zurich, and backed by top-tier Silicon Valley investors, we are building the intelligence layer that powers the legal industry. Every firm can license the same AI models, but no two firms share the same institutional knowledge. Decades of experience, work product, and precedent are often trapped across systems, underused and inaccessible. DeepJudge makes this expertise instantly available through world-class enterprise search and AI infrastructure, enabling firms to automate workflows, build knowledge-powered applications, and turn experience into a lasting advantage. Our technology is trusted by many of the world’s leading law firms, including Freshfields, Gunderson Dettmer, Holland & Knight, Arent Fox, and Cozen O’Connor. Headquartered in Switzerland with a growing team across North America, we are expanding rapidly and shaping the future of how professional knowledge is discovered and applied. At DeepJudge, we move fast, think rigorously, and care deeply about what we build. We combine cutting-edge research with close collaboration with our clients to deliver solutions that truly make an impact. If you want to be part of a team defining how AI transforms high-stakes knowledge work, this is the place to do it. About the role: As a Site Reliability Engineer at DeepJudge, you own the reliability of the systems that leading law firms depend on every day. We run our AI search platform in dedicated production environments, each a large-scale search and retrieval system operating at very high data volumes, alongside our ingestion pipelines and data stores, on container-orchestrated infrastructure across multiple public and private clouds. Keeping those environments fast, available, and trustworthy is a genuine engineering challenge, and it's your mission.

jobs.title: Global Investigator (Triage)
jobs.description: Build a Safer World. TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure. As a Global Investigator on the triage team, you will be the first line of operational defense in a fast-moving crypto disruption pipeline. You will process inbound complaint data, validate outputs from our artificial-intelligence (AI) investigation platform, and route cases into the investigative pipelines that result in frozen scam proceeds and seized assets. You will hold the disposition pen: your call is what turns a complaint into a freeze, a takedown, a recovery handoff, a legal-process draft, a victim notification, or a close. The impact you will have: Validate and route hundreds of complaint dispositions per week, feeding a live asset-recovery pipeline. Catch the AI errors that matter, such as false positives, merged syndicates, and misclassified scam patterns, before they propagate downstream. Enrich complaint selectors using a stack of more than forty commercial data-source integrations. Own clean shift handoffs so the around-the-clock operation never drops a lead, providing EMEA-hours coverage that keeps the queue moving while colleagues in other regions are offline. What we’re looking for: Investigative or analytical experience in the private or public sector. One to three years is fine: we want hungry people who want to grow into deep crypto expertise. Strong AI fluency, meaning comfort using AI tools as a daily co-pilot, plus the judgment to know when they are wrong. Excitement to deepen blockchain analysis skills. Comfort operating in a fast-paced, fluid environment where the project's scope and emphasis may shift quarter to quarter. Strong written and verbal communication. About the

jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.description: Who we are Foundation models transformed text and images. Structured data - the largest and most consequential data format in the world - stayed untouched, until now. What LLMs did for language, we're doing for tables. We pioneered tabular foundation models: TabPFN v2 was a Nature cover story, has passed 3.5M+ downloads and 7,500+ GitHub stars, and runs in production from detecting lung disease with Oxford Cancer Analytics to preventing train failures with Hitachi . The hardest problems - millions of rows, real-time inference, entirely new modalities - are still open, and no one else is working on them at this level. We're a small, highly selective team of 40+ with backgrounds from Google, DeepMind, Meta, Apple, Amazon, Jane Street, and CERN, led by Frank Hutter , Noah Hollmann , and Sauraj Gambhir , and advised by Bernhard Schölkopf and Turing Award winner Yann LeCun. In July 2026, less than 18 months after our €9M pre-seed, we joined SAP as an independent frontier AI lab - same team, mission, and open-weights models, now backed by more than €1 billion over four years. The role You will be our first dedicated engineering leader, reporting to the CTO with a direct line to both founders - no layers in between. Today, engineering at Prior Labs is a small, very senior team. We plan to grow it substantially over the next 18 months, and your job is to build and run that organization. Specification and standards management: Implement relevant standards for intelligent building management solutions, process automation, and safety systems, such as IEC 61511 (functional safety) and ATEX regulations. jobs.title: Scientific Account Executive
jobs.description: Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments. We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world. We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today. Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development. We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation. About the role This is a hybrid sales and customer success role for someone with real scientific depth. You'll be the primary point of contact for customers — from first conversation through ongoing engagement. That means understanding what a protein design team is actually trying to achieve, helping them pick the right assays, making sure their experiments are set up correctly, and translating results back into language that's useful for their programs. The day-to-day: Running technical sales calls where you discuss binding kinetics, expression systems, and assay design, not just pricing Onboarding new customers and helping them design their first experiments on the platform Monitoring ongoing accounts, flagging issues early, and proactively suggesting next steps based on their results

From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have. Are you ready to join us? JOB DESCRIPTION: Back Market is building AI-powered customer care experiences through Fin, its customer-facing AI Agent. Fin helps customers with pre-sales questions, delivery tracking, and technical troubleshooting. As an AI Quality & Evaluation Intern, you will work with the QA Lead to monitor Fin’s performance, review conversations, identify recurring issues, and help improve the quality evaluation process. You will collaborate with content, product, data, and engineering teams to turn your findings into concrete improvements. YOUR MISSION (IF YOU ACCEPT IT): 🥇 Operate and improve quality monitors and scorecards covering accuracy, policy compliance, connector use, escalation quality, tone, hallucinations, and unsupported claims. Review flagged and unflagged conversations to identify false positives, false negatives, and recurring defects. Prepare the weekly quality review by summarizing key findings, risks, and root causes. Share clear, actionable feedback with product, engineering, content, and data team

jobs.description: Direction de Projets – Ingénierie, Construction & Infrastructures Critiques 1. Présentation du poste Intitulé : Directeur de Projet Data Center (Data Center Project Director) Rattachement hiérarchique : Directeur des Opérations / Directeur de Programme / Direction Générale Périmètre : France et International Secteur : Data Centers – Infrastructures critiques – Construction – Ingénierie 2. Mission principale Le Directeur de Projet Data Center assure le pilotage stratégique, technique, opérationnel et financier de projets complexes de conception, de construction, d'extension ou de transformation de Data Centers. Il garantit la bonne exécution des projets dans le respect des engagements contractuels, des budgets, des délais, des exigences de qualité, de sécurité, de performance énergétique et de disponibilité des infrastructures. Il intervient sur l'ensemble du cycle de vie des projets, depuis les études de faisabilité jusqu'à la réception des installations, leur mise en service et leur transfert aux équipes d'exploitation. Véritable chef d'orchestre, il coordonne les différentes parties prenantes et assure l'interface entre la maîtrise d'ouvrage, la maîtrise d'œuvre, les bureaux d'études, les entreprises de construction, les fournisseurs et les exploitants. 3. Responsabilités principales A. Direction et pilotage stratégique des projets Définir la stratégie globale d'exécution et les objectifs du projet. Piloter des projets de Data Centers neufs (Greenfield), d'extension ou de rénovation (Brownfield). Superviser toutes les phases du projet, de la faisabilité à la livraison. Définir les jalons, les livrables et les indicateurs de performance. Mettre en place la gouvernance et les instances de décision. Arbitrer les choix techniques, économiques et organisationnels. Anticiper les risques et définir les plans d'atténuation. Assurer le reporting auprès de la Direction Générale, des investisseurs et des clients. B. Management technique et coordination des études Superviser

jobs.title: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks
jobs.description: We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want. You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models. Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week. How it works Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another. Requirements 2+ years of professional software engineering Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code) Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++ Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing Regular use of an AI coding tool Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words At least 10 hours a week, starting now A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines) Nice to have Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure Experience building agent
